About Me

Mere alfaazon ki chhoti si duniya

Main Shweta hoon. Kavita mere liye sirf shabd nahi, balki dil ke ehsaason ko sambhalne aur unhe apne andaaz mein kehne ka ek khoobsurat zariya hai. Is website par meri kavitaayein meri apni handwriting mein hain, kyunki inmein meri awaaz aur meri pehchaan dono basi hain.
